% Pattern: proof/wrapper/article. A wrapper of proof, attached by the number
% in its head (rule 2), far from the statement.
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2 status=here
% want proofof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1
% want proofof-2 proof - proves=theorem-2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newenvironment{proofof}[1]{\begin{proof}[Proof of #1]}{\end{proof}}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
First result.
\end{theorem}
Some text.
\begin{theorem}
Second result.
\end{theorem}
\section{Proofs}
\begin{proofof}{Theorem 1}
Proof one.
\end{proofof}
\begin{proofof}{Theorem~2}
Proof two.
\end{proofof}
\end{document}
